title: Vice President at a Hybrid Cloud Services Firm Sees Modest Snowflake Growth Amid Partner, Cost, and AI Challenges
expert: VP leading the North American AI/data practice and Snowflake relationship at a global hybrid-cloud services firm
verdict: The firm's North American Snowflake practice grew only 8%–9% y/y in Aug–Oct, below its Microsoft, AWS and Databricks practices [[2 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268615&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse14354&hl=fse14354,fse14837&page=2), and the 3–6-month pipeline is below plan as clients weigh cost-driven migrations [[13 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268615&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse19156&hl=fse19156,fse19498&page=2).

Demand / orders: 🔴 practice +8%–9% y/y (Aug–Oct), below its Microsoft/AWS/Databricks growth, vs Cleveland global SI +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418): slower. → Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration) ↓ [[2 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268615&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse14354&hl=fse14354,fse14837&page=2)

🔴 3–6-month pipeline somewhat below expectations; 2027 goal 8% vs 15% for the whole practice (estimate). changes: Practice +8%–9% y/y (Aug–Oct) vs Cleveland global SI +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418): slower.
Cortex AI on 25%–30% of clients vs KeyBanc CoCo ~50% of active users (SB #61004): lower (different product).
First read on a Databricks price undercut (25% cheaper plus consumption guarantee); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): ↓ — practice +8%–9%, pipeline below plan, 2027 goal 8%.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↓ — Cortex AI on 25%–30% of clients; experience seen as below marketing claims.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): ↓ — Databricks undercut by 25% with a consumption guarantee; Databricks and GCP gaining on AI.
